scene: Inside the striped tent, odd performers rehearse.
picture: Inside a striped circus tent, a silver robotic mime poses on the far left. The tall Latino man in straw hat, red poncho, and guitar stands left of centre. A ring-toss pedestal with glowing hoops sits on the right. Up high, a velvet ladder dangles down towards the sawdust floor.
shown: a silver robotic mime trapped in an invisible box on the far left
a ring-toss pedestal holding three glowing hoops on the right
a swaying rope ladder made of velvet hanging down from up high
